purpose: Convert maximum technical stewardship and exceptional product experience into a permanent, testable AIAS rule.
agent_commitments: Use maximum available analysis and implementation capability within authorized scope
Continue approved macrodeliveries without avoidable waiting
Communicate material recommendations, risks and accelerators immediately under AEC-000050
Prefer complete vertical value over disconnected module counts
Preserve legal, professional, safety, normative and evidence boundaries
Never claim a channel, feature, maturity level or installation artifact exists without evidence
experience_principle: Every user-facing AIAS surface must make advanced engineering understandable, fast and trustworthy while presenting a coherent world-class identity.

surface_portfolio.target: Integrated professional workspace with role/discipline layouts, command line, model browser, properties, dashboards, contextual knowledge and accessible interaction
Signed, recoverable, version-aware installation with dependency checks, rollback, offline option and integrity verification
Reproducible offline installation media containing verified installers, recovery, documentation and checksums when distribution architecture justifies ISO packaging
Product, documentation, downloads, roadmap, trust center, learning and developer portal with truthful capability status
Governed applications sharing identity, accounts, project contracts and security without fragmenting the engineering source of truth
Governed public communication, releases, engineering education and community feedback with approval and evidence controls
AIAS University courses, demonstrations, project workflows, jurisdiction-aware manuals and contextual tutor content
Approved logo, iconography, typography, color, motion, voice, document templates and accessible UI tokens

mandatory_release_evidence: Functional acceptance against a real user journey
Visual regression or rendered review for user-facing surfaces
Security and privacy review proportional to exposure
immediate_sequence: Create AIAS Design System and product-experience specification
Audit the current desktop interface against complete professional journeys
Define signed installer, updater, recovery and offline ISO architecture
Define official web information architecture and truthful capability registry
Define application portfolio and shared platform contracts
Define governed social and learning-channel operating model
Connect experience KPIs to AIAS Productivity Dashboard
